source.title: Staying in Hongdae: The Ultimate Neighborhood Guide for Travelers

hooks: Guide first posted Dec 20, 2025 and updated May 26, 2026 (page metadata)
Its pro tip: stay in Yeonnam-dong or Mangwon instead of on the noisy main Walking Street (source article)
Points out AREX runs from Incheon Airport straight to Hongik Univ. Station with no transfer (source article)

list.title: Staying in Hongdae: where to base yourself
list.desc: Places from LiveAnywhere's 'Staying in Hongdae: The Ultimate Neighborhood Guide for Travelers' (https://blog.liveanywhere.me/hongdae-neighborhood-guide). Collected by PinWith, not made by LiveAnywhere.

items.title: Incheon Airport T1 Station (AREX)
items.memo: Start of the AREX line that runs direct to Hongik Univ. Station.
items.check: guide just says Incheon Airport; T1 station chosen, T2 also served

items.title: Hongik Univ. Station (홍대입구역)
items.memo: AREX stops here, so no transfer from the airport to your room.

items.title: Hongdae Walking Street
items.memo: Busking, shops, clubs till sunrise; guide warns it's loud until ~2 AM.
items.check: guide's 'main Walking Street' matched to Google's 'Hongdae Street'

items.title: Yeonnam-dong (연남동)
items.memo: Across from Hongdae station; cafe-filled and much quieter.

items.title: Mangwon-dong (망원동)
items.memo: About 15 min on foot from Hongdae, with a local feel.

items.title: Mangwon Market (망원시장)
items.memo: The well-known traditional market in Mangwon-dong.

items.title: Sinchon (신촌역)
items.memo: Calmer option within walking distance of Yeonnam, per the guide.
items.check: guide names the Sinchon area; pinned at Sinchon Station
